title: Introducing the Enhanced Spyglass Tool
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, bringing you a robust and refined tool designed to elevate your workflows.

title: Complete Control Over Your Files in the Editor
summary: Effortlessly manage, upload, and customize the display of all your files directly within the editor for a more streamlined and visually engaging experience.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Our new public roadmap offers a transparent and engaging view into our product's evolution, showcasing recently shipped features, what's launching next, and our exciting future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a smoother experience with our newly enhanced checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and effortlessly draggable, beautifully matching the rest of your interface.

title: Seamless Team Editing
summary: Experience smoother, more intuitive real-time collaboration with clearer indicators, making teamwork effortless and productive.

title: Enhanced Shared Item Discovery
summary: We've significantly improved the visibility and discoverability of shared items, making it easier than ever to collaborate and achieve your goals together.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Expand Noeko's reach to users worldwide by offering support for a variety of international languages.

title: Noeko: Now Open Source!
summary: We're opening up Noeko's codebase to give you ultimate control, foster direct community involvement, and ensure complete transparency.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Navigate your knowledge base with unprecedented precision as the Constellation view gains powerful new filters for tags, time, and shared connections, making it an indispensable tool for discovery and workflow.

title: Discover Your Knowledge with Enhanced Search
summary: Unlock a new level of productivity by precisely filtering, sorting, and saving your search results into personalized collections, making it easier than ever to find and organize your most relevant information.

title: Dynamic Note Layouts
summary: We're introducing dynamic new ways to arrange and interact with your notes, empowering you to visualize your thoughts and connections more intuitively.

title: Noeko: Flexible Hosting and Premium Features
summary: Get ready for Noeko's official launch, bringing you flexible hosting options and premium features designed to empower your team's unique needs.

title: Elevate Your Experience with Stunning New Themes
summary: Get ready for a visual upgrade as we enhance current themes and roll out a variety of fresh, stylish options to perfectly match your preferences.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: We're enhancing our app to display accurate, time-sensitive greetings, ensuring a consistently personalized and delightful experience throughout your day.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Effortlessly organize your tagged content by enabling the quick removal of tags from multiple items directly within your lists, boosting your productivity.

title: Bring All Your Content Together
summary: Effortlessly bring all your valuable information into your workflow by seamlessly integrating new content sources like YouTube videos, websites, and text files.
